Types

ShapeError = object of CatchableError
  kind*: ShapeErrorKind      ## Which shaping check failed.
  planDirection*: Direction  ## Plan direction for mismatch errors.
  bufferDirection*: Direction ## Buffer direction for mismatch errors.
  planScript*: Script        ## Plan script for mismatch errors.
  bufferScript*: Script      ## Buffer script for mismatch errors.
Shaping failure carrying plan and buffer context. 
ShapeErrorKind = enum
  seAlreadyShaped,          ## Buffer already holds shaped glyphs.
  seDirectionUnset,         ## Buffer has no direction set.
  seDirectionMismatch,      ## Buffer direction does not match the plan direction.
  seScriptMismatch           ## Buffer script does not match the plan script.
Classifies shaping failures.
